name: mirage
text:
Yes, working and v1.0.23 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.23 . It fixes (1) Kalshi rows now obey your 'at least N books' filter like Novig rows, (2) Kalshi bids go in at 1 contract even when that is above Kelly (your 22:06 word). Still open: the Kalshi toggle lag; tell me which screen lags if it persists after updating.

APIs, from the engine's own measurements: GOOD: ParlayAPI, PropLine (both fresh, ~2 min), BoltOdds and Kalshi/Polymarket/Pinnacle feeds (under 1 s), SGO (7 min old but closest to Pinnacle, 1.2 pts). Nothing needs buying. REFRESH: only OddsPapi Free (v4): 9 of 250 requests left, resets Nov 1; it is a minor backup, so I would not pay for it. OddsPapi v5, Unabated and The Odds API are not being measured because the better feeds answer first, so they rest.
